summary: XP Inc. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that director Martin Emiliano Escobari Lifchitz voluntarily resigned from the Board effective October 16, 2026, expressly not due to any disagreement, and that the Board by unanimous written resolution appointed Rodrigo Kede Lima as interim independent director effective the same day, serving until the 2027 annual general meeting. No price, stake, premium, advisor or regulatory clock is involved; the resignation letter includes standard release and no-undisclosed-violation confirmations. Routine board succession, not a special situation; watch nothing material for arbitrage.
